script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

DR. FRANKLIN (50s, passionate scientist) hunches over a large computer console, eyes red from lack of sleep. He glances up as DR. WILLIAMS (30s, calm and collected) enters the room.

DR. WILLIAMS
(softly)
You're still here?

DR. FRANKLIN
(frustrated)
I can't stop now. We're on the brink of a breakthrough.

DR. WILLIAMS
(sighs)
What if I told you there was a way to harness the power of the universe itself?

Dr. Franklin looks up, intrigued.

DR. FRANKLIN
(excited)
You're not serious?

DR. WILLIAMS
(smiles)
I'll show you.

INT. LABORATORY - THE NEXT DAY

The two scientists work together, their minds focused on the project. They make breakthrough after breakthrough, their friendship growing stronger with each passing day.

DR. FRANKLIN
(laughs)
I can't believe we're finally doing it.

DR. WILLIAMS
(grinning)
We're going to change the world.

INT. LABORATORY - A WEEK LATER

The project is complete, and the two scientists stand before their creation: a massive machine that glows with an otherworldly light.

DR. FRANKLIN
(in awe)
It's beautiful.

DR. WILLIAMS
(proudly)
It's the future of humanity.

INT. CITY STREETS - DAY

The machine is transported to the city, where it is set up in a central location. People gather to witness the spectacle.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The machine, named the "Unity Engine," promised to provide limitless clean energy to the world.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Dr. Franklin and Dr. Williams stand before the machine, exhausted but proud of their achievement.

DR. FRANKLIN
(looking at Dr. Williams)
We did it.

DR. WILLIAMS
(smiling)
Yes, we did.

INT. CITY SQUARE - DAY

The Unity Engine is officially launched, and the city is bathed in a brilliant, pulsing light. The people cheer, their faces filled with awe and wonder.

DR. FRANKLIN
(whispering to Dr. Williams)
This is just the beginning.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Months later, the scientists continue to work on new projects, their friendship unbroken by the challenges they face.

DR. FRANKLIN
(looking at Dr. Williams)
We've come so far.

DR. WILLIAMS
(nodding)
But there's always more to discover.

INT. CITY SQUARE - DAY

The Unity Engine continues to provide energy to the city, and the world is a better place because of it. Dr. Franklin and Dr. Williams watch as the sun sets, their friendship a beacon of hope and innovation.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The bond between Dr. Franklin and Dr. Williams proved that true progress can be made without the need for violence or destruction.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
